zh.title: 阿提哈德航空擴大與越南航空共掛班號合作　新增河內－高雄航線
zh.summary: 阿提哈德航空與越南航空的共掛班號合作進一步延伸至河內－高雄航線，VN584、VN586、VN585與VN587均新增對應EY班號。
body: 阿提哈德航空（Etihad Airways）與越南航空（Vietnam Airlines）的共掛班號合作範圍進一步延伸至臺灣南部市場。最新航班資料顯示，由越南航空實際營運的河內內排國際機場（HAN）－高雄國際機場（KHH）航線，目前已同步掛上阿提哈德航空「EY」航班代碼，讓阿提哈德航空旅客可透過其航班編號使用越南航空往返河內與高雄的服務。
在河內飛往高雄方向，越南航空VN586同步使用阿提哈德航空EY7304班號；VN584則共掛EY7320。反方向由高雄飛往河內，VN587共掛EY7305，VN585則使用EY7321。航班仍由越南航空負責實際營運，阿提哈德航空則以行銷航空公司的身分販售相關航段。航班追蹤資料亦已將EY7304、EY7305及EY7321等班號標示為越南航空營運的共掛班號航班。
目前越南航空在河內－高雄市場安排多個航班時段。高雄機場航班資料顯示，VN584、VN586負責河內飛往高雄，VN585及VN587則執飛高雄返回河內，其中部分班次為每日營運，其餘依不同日期安排。現階段相關航班主要使用Airbus A321系列窄體客機執飛。
阿提哈德航空與越南航空的最新一輪共掛班號合作自2025年11月21日起正式展開，配合阿提哈德航空開闢阿布達比與河內之間的航線，讓EY旅客得以透過越南航空的航網銜接越南國內及其他亞洲目的地。雙方同時建立Etihad Guest與Lotusmiles常旅客計畫合作，使會員能在符合資格的航班累積及兌換里程。
河內－高雄納入合作後，阿提哈德航空的EY班號也進一步出現在臺灣南部市場。對經河內轉機的旅客而言，這項安排增加阿提哈德航空與越南航空網路之間的銜接選擇；實際航班時刻、營運日期及可售共掛班號仍可能隨航空公司的季節班表調整。

en.title: Etihad Expands Vietnam Airlines Codeshare to Hanoi–Kaohsiung Route
en.summary: Etihad Airways has expanded its codeshare partnership with Vietnam Airlines to the Hanoi–Kaohsiung route, adding EY flight numbers to VN584, VN586, VN585 and VN587.
body: Etihad Airways and Vietnam Airlines have further expanded their codeshare partnership into southern Taiwan. Current flight data shows that Vietnam Airlines' Hanoi Noi Bai International Airport (HAN)–Kaohsiung International Airport (KHH) service now also carries Etihad Airways' EY flight codes, allowing Etihad customers to book the Vietnam Airlines-operated service between Hanoi and Kaohsiung under Etihad flight numbers.

On services from Hanoi to Kaohsiung, Vietnam Airlines flight VN586 also operates under Etihad flight number EY7304, while VN584 carries EY7320. In the opposite direction from Kaohsiung to Hanoi, VN587 carries EY7305 and VN585 carries EY7321. Vietnam Airlines remains the operating carrier, while Etihad acts as the marketing carrier for the codeshare sectors. Flight-tracking data also identifies EY7304, EY7305 and EY7321 as codeshare services operated by Vietnam Airlines.

Vietnam Airlines currently schedules several flight timings in the Hanoi–Kaohsiung market. Kaohsiung Airport flight information lists VN584 and VN586 from Hanoi to Kaohsiung, with VN585 and VN587 operating the return sectors to Hanoi. Some services operate daily while others vary by date. The route is currently operated mainly with Airbus A321-family narrowbody aircraft.

The latest phase of the Etihad Airways–Vietnam Airlines codeshare partnership formally began on November 21, 2025, alongside Etihad's launch of service between Abu Dhabi and Hanoi. The arrangement enables Etihad passengers to connect through Vietnam Airlines' network to domestic destinations in Vietnam and other points across Asia. The two airlines also established cooperation between the Etihad Guest and Lotusmiles frequent-flyer programs, allowing members to earn and redeem miles on eligible flights.

With Hanoi–Kaohsiung now included in the partnership, Etihad's EY flight code has also extended further into the southern Taiwan market. For passengers connecting through Hanoi, the arrangement provides additional itinerary options across the Etihad Airways and Vietnam Airlines networks. Actual schedules, operating days and the availability of codeshare flight numbers may still change with seasonal timetable adjustments.
